Earlier, the bubble itself had opened that page too. So once tried, it is plainly one place with one title, 'New note'. But beforehand nothing on the home screen used the word 'note'. During this one session the bubble's words also changed on their own: 'Share a song' when I first looked, then 'Drop a thought', and 'What's up?' in the captured pictures. I could not have known these were all the same feature until I pressed them.

out_of_scope.why: The round purple button floats over the right half of an 'Add friend' button, so a press meant for 'Add friend' could land on it. That is a matter of one control covering another, not of what the button does.
The box around the gear is shifted so the gear sits at its left edge; I would aim for the gear, not the box.
Some of the text is small and the screens are busy; I had to read slowly. That is about text size and density, not about whether the controls behave alike.

The picture is the same everywhere, so it is consistent, but I cannot tell what it does, and on the chat list it covers half of an 'Add friend' button, so I could press it by accident when I meant to add someone.
